content.title: Costco members are suing over a membership charge; can Mass. join?
content.text: Costco, known for its cult-like following and hard-to-beat bulk deals, is facing a class-action lawsuit from members who say the warehouse giant quietly charged their cards for membership renewals without giving them enough warning to cancel. The lawsuit was filed in March by California shopper Russel George II, who says he signed up for a $65 Gold Star membership online in 2023 — and had started reconsidering whether to keep it by late 2025. Before he could cancel, his card was charged on Jan. 2, 2026. George says Costco did send him an email heads-up — but 60 days before the charge, which is actually too early under California law. Read more: Costco recalls products nationwide after 5 people sustain injuries in collapses The state’s Automatic Renewal Law requires companies to notify customers between 15 and 45 days before charging — not two months out. The lawsuit also claims the notice left out key details California requires, including how much he’d be charged, the terms of the renewal and how to cancel. “Had Plaintiff been provided this notice in a timely manner, he would have cancelled his membership and not gone forward with the autorenewal,” the complaint states. George sent Costco a formal demand letter in January. Costco responded in February but refused to fix it, according to the filing. Read more: 740K pans sold at Costco, Walmart, Amazon being recalled over burn risk: Return ASAP The lawsuit followed weeks later, seeking damages and an injunction that would force Costco to overhaul how it notifies all members before renewals. The complaint argues George isn’t alone — pointing to Reddit threads and Better Business Bureau complaints from other members with similar gripes. Costco operates at least 133 stores in California alone, and the proposed class could number in the thousands. The suit is filed under California law, so Massachusetts shoppers can’t join the class — but if you’ve ever been surprised by a Costco renewal charge, you probably understand the frustration. There are more than a dozen Costco locations across the state. Members can check their renewal date or manage auto-renewal at Costco.com or by calling 1-800-774-2678. This is the latest lawsuit to hit Costco in recent months, following suits over its rotisserie chicken, a salmonella contamination claim at a Nebraska processing plant and allegations it passed illegal tariff costs onto shoppers.
